name: PhD Programs in Biomedical and Biological Sciences (PIBBS)

english.note: English proficiency evidence required for international applicants unless exempt. USC numerical thresholds on the central page concern exemption from the ISE placement exam, not admission minimums.

applicationFee.note: Waivers offered for qualifying categories; financial-hardship waivers are domestic-only. International applicants should confirm eligibility for other categories with the program.

documents: Scanned official transcripts from all institutions attended
requirements.note: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required; research ability/experience expected. Application text still refers to six tracks while the home page lists five; no track list inferred.

publishedDeadlines.label: Full consideration
publishedDeadlines.note: Published without an admission year; confirm the applicable cycle with the program.

funding.note: Funding covers tuition, stipend and health benefits while the student remains in good academic standing. No blanket international funding guarantee inferred.
